user.title: Add your Beacon lights
user.description: Choose where the Bluetooth adapter is connected.

local.title: Local USB Bluetooth
local.description: Select a Bluetooth adapter accessible to Home Assistant. For Docker or LXC, the host must expose the adapter and permit Bluetooth HCI access.

remote.title: Bluetooth on another machine
remote.description: Connect to the Beacon Cooked service on the machine that has your Bluetooth adapter. Then add the lights here.

menu_options.known_devices: Test or rebind an existing light

scan.title: Find your light
scan.description: Put the intended light in pairing mode, then submit. Scanning takes eight seconds. If it is already configured, return to the menu and select existing lights.

select_device.title: Choose a discovered light
select_device.description: Only devices matching the observed Tuya Beacon packet format are listed. Compatibility is checked with a color test.

bind.title: Associate {name}
bind.description: Keep other lights out of their binding windows. Switch this light off. Submit, then immediately switch it on: the remote association is transmitted for 15 seconds. This is a normal power cycle, not a factory reset. You will test the color next.

data.only_target: Only the intended light will be powered on during association

test.title: Test {name}
test.description: Choose a color and submit. Check the actual light, not just its HA state.

verify.title: Did {name} change color?
verify.description: The test color was {color}. Confirm only if the actual light changed. If it did not, retry association. Some firmware requires initial activation with the Tuya app before a virtual remote can be bound.

added.title: {name} is ready
added.description: Its control was physically confirmed. Finish to create or refresh the light in Home Assistant, or add another light.

error.invalid_gateway: Invalid Bluetooth host address or response
error.no_devices: No compatible announcements received. Make sure the light is in pairing mode, then scan again.
error.cannot_enroll: Could not save the selected light. Scan again.
error.isolate_target: Confirm that only the intended light will enter its binding window
error.local_unavailable: Home Assistant cannot access this USB Bluetooth adapter
error.no_local_adapter: No local Bluetooth adapter is exposed to Home Assistant

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Open the integration options to add lights.
